## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector-level strength (Materials, Energy, Industrials leading) but major divergence among megacap Tech (AAPL, NVDA, AMD BELOW TREND) and several large-cap reversals; Leadership concentrated (Tech & Energy account for 4/5 of top performers).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +26.18%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +13.93%) — Sector Strength: Materials 7/7 positive. Energy strong: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) — Energy 8/8 positive. Industrials robust: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +16.28%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +17.05%) — Industrials 11/13 positive.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology mixed but lagging on marquee names: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%) — Tech: 13/19 positive (Internal Rotation). Utilities weakest: XLU names down, Utilities 1/6 positive — Sector Weakness. Real Estate soft: AMT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -5.24%), CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -6.14%) — Real Estate 5/6 positive (but under pressure).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%). Leadership: Concentrated (Tech & Energy account for 4/5 top performers) — cyclical/value bias.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AIG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -0.78%), AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%), CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -6.14%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%), ABBV BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%). Weakness concentrated in select Financials and large-cap Tech/Pharma names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%). Watch divergence: MSFT RECOVERY signal (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -2.59%), META POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -0.51%) — MAJOR divergence among large caps.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed rotation and selective strength; GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +3.62%) and AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) versus AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) and AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%). Sector breadth: 13/19 positive — Internal Rotation; watch for continued megacap dispersion.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Cyclical but mixed; JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.04%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +7.13%) with pockets of stress (CME BELOW TREND (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -2.39%)). Sector breadth: 12/20 positive — Internal Rotation with selective bank/fintech risk.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Modestly constructive with select strength and exhaustion signs; UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +6.30%), LLY TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +8.28%) but ISRG showing bullish news flow. Sector breadth: 12/15 positive — Defensive underpinning but idiosyncratic moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals/value exposure given Materials/Energy/Industrials leadership (FCX, SLB, LMT ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names that show trend exhaustion (AAPL, AMD, NVDA BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth/Momentum while MAJOR divergence among megacaps resolves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +26.18%). BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%), AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%), AIG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -0.78%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (7/7 positive) and Energy (8/8 positive) on strong momentum and commodity tailwinds. BEARISH: Utilities (1/6 positive) and select Tech names showing profit-taking — watch breadth within Tech (13/19 positive).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
INTC above-trend continuation level: near-term follow-through if it holds 1W gains; AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) to confirm breakout above recent range; AAPL BELOW TREND key support test around recent 1M lows — sustained weakness would deepen tech dispersion.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+70): FDA/da Vinci uptake headline; price ABOVE TREND signal in the sector — sentiment confirming strength. IBM (+60): Confluent deal positive; IBM showing strength (1W movement supportive) — sentiment confirming. LLY (+55): Positive clinical data; LLY TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +8.28%) — news bullish but short-term pullback, watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
GS (-50): Apple Card win headline tied to JPM/GS conflict — GS pressure aligns with idiosyncratic flows; GS shows weakness in recent moves. QCOM (-50): Downgrade headline; QCOM price underperforming (watch for confirmation). AAPL (-45): Negative AI strategic headlines; AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) — sentiment and price confirm distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Materials/Energy/Industrials leadership and strong overall breadth (10/11 sectors positive). INTC, SLB, AMAT, AMZN, FCX showing relative strength (ALL ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major-cap Tech dispersion and MAJOR divergence (MSFT, META, TSLA showing 1W/1M splits and AAPL/NVDA/AMD BELOW TREND) — watch sentiment-confirmation for these names.
